target_year_over_year_context.explanation: Both disclosures define the general accounting policy for Available-for-Sale (AFS) investment securities. D069 states AFS securities are reported at fair value with interest income in the income statement and unrealized gains/losses in OCI/Other revenues. D062 mirrors this, stating AFS securities are reported at fair value, interest income is included in Interest income, and unrealized gains/losses are recorded in OCI or Other revenues.

previous_disclosures.section: Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements > AFS Investment Securities
previous_disclosures.summary: Available-for-sale (AFS) securities are reported at fair value, with interest income included in the income statement and unrealized gains/losses recorded in OCI or Other revenues depending on impairment status. The firm evaluates unrealized loss positions to determine if an intent to sell or requirement to sell exists; if so, the amortized cost basis is written down to fair value with the loss recognized in Other revenues and any established allowance for credit losses (ACL) written off.

comparisons.peer_topic: Reporting and Classification Details for Level 3 Instruments
comparisons.peer_summary: Level 3 derivatives are presented on a net basis. Realized and unrealized gains/losses on Level 3 AFS securities were not material for 2024-2022, with unrealized gains/losses due to DVA for fair value option elected liabilities reported in OCI as $(50) million, $(158) million, and $(529) million respectively. Other items include changes in fair value for MSRs in mortgage fees, DVA in principal transactions revenue, loan originations included in purchases, and maturities/repayments.
comparisons.comparison: Both MS and JPM describe the recognition of unrealized gains and losses for AFS securities in OCI. MS states that unrealized gains are recorded in OCI and losses are recorded in OCI or Other revenues. JPM confirms that for AFS securities, unrealized gains/losses are reported in OCI, and specifically notes that realized and unrealized gains/losses on Level 3 AFS securities were not material for the years ended 2024, 2023, and 2022, adding a materiality context to the standard policy.
